text:
alex: Heads-up — we're doing a preflight for the new EU/US hybrid org (eu-west1 + us-central1) that will run A100 instances + some NCv3 fallback in Azure. Need a concise checklist to request GPU quotas, network egress allowances, and billing exports. Keeping it minimal for the SRE handoff.

jamie: +1. Can we include both soft-limit requests (fast approval) and hard-limit invites for long-term capacity? Also call out tag and billing export requirements. :white_check_mark:

sara: Drafting checklist now. Quick items I think we need: account metadata, required VM families and counts per region, expected concurrency, peak QPS, nat/egress estimates, IAM roles, tag policy, and support case templates.

mike: Add a tiny cost calc so finance can pre-approve reserved capacity if quota is approved. rough numbers: A100-40GB ~ $4.50/hr (hosted list price) x 10 machines x 24hr x 30d -> ~ $3,240/mo baseline. Include note this is estimate and vendor pricing varies.

infra-bot: auto-note: create ticket INFRA-PRFL-2026 when checklist final. reminder: attach support-case drafts.

alex: Ok, here's a compact checklist I put together. Please comment inline and we'll send to cloud support + internal ops.

sara: paste the checklist here and I'll refine wording for the vendor support requests.

alex: 
1) Org & project info: org id, billing account id, owner contact (email + phone).
2) Regions: eu-west1 (primary), us-central1 (secondary) — list quotas per region.
3) GPU families & targets: 
   - GCP A2 (A100) : target 12 GPUs in eu-west1, 8 GPUs in us-central1 (soft)
   - AWS p4d (or p3dn fallback): target 8 GPUs in eu-west-1, request simultaneous limit increase to 16 (hard)
   - Azure NCv3/ND series fallback: request quota for 8 instances in westeurope
4) Network: NAT gateway bandwidth, 10Gb egress soft limit -> request production bandwidth raise + note expected peak egress 5TB/mo
5) IAM & service accounts: provide template roles for deploy, monitoring, cost-export.
6) Tags & labels: required keys: `business_unit`, `team`, `env`, `project_slug`, `cost_center`. enforce on create.
7) Billing: enable daily billing export to central BigQuery/S3, attach billing contact.
8) SLA & escalation path: include our SRE on the cloud ticket; list phone and account manager.
9) Fallback plan: pre-approved reserved spot for non-critical workloads and fallback smaller GPUs if A100 unavailable.
10) Cost estimate: baseline + 20% headroom; provide currency and assumptions.

jamie: For vendor support cases, here's a short template we can send verbatim. Use the provider-specific fields below.

--- AWS support case (example) ---
```
Subject: Request GPU quota increase for new org - Redwood Inference (eu-west-1)
Body:
Hello,
We are provisioning a new organization account for Redwood Inference.
Account/Billing ID: 1234-ABCD
Requested resource: EC2 p4d.24xlarge (NVIDIA A100) limit increase
Current limit: 0
Requested soft limit: 8 instances
Requested hard limit: 16 instances
Regions: eu-west-1 (primary), us-east-1 (secondary fallback)
Estimated monthly usage: ~3,240 USD (see attached calc)
Use case: Low-latency LLM inference; workloads are production and have SLA requirements.
Please route to capacity team and include SRE contact: alex@redwood.ai, +1-555-0100.
Thanks,
Redwood Inference Infrastructure
```
---

sara: Good. Add a short CI/CD note asking for per-account instance type whitelisting so infra can spin up without manual approval.

alex: Done. Also add a GCP support example: 

--- GCP quota request example ---
```
Project ID: redwood-eu-prod
Billing account: 012345-6789
Quota: "GPUs (all regions)" or per-type A100 (a2-highgpu) in eu-west1
Current limit: 0
Requested soft limit: 12 GPUs in eu-west1
Requested hard limit: 20 GPUs across brands
Rationale: Model serving with KV cache; predictable throughput. Peak QPS: 120 requests/sec. Expected monthly egress: 5TB.
Contacts: alex@redwood.ai, jamie@redwood.ai
Please flag for expedited review and routing to capacity/planner.
```
---

mike: For Azure: include subscription id and ask for NCv3/ND quotas with fallback plan. Also request VM family whitelisting and accelerated networking enabled by default.

alex: Network cost notes: NAT + egress in eu-west1 estimated $0.09/GB. For 5TB/mo -> ~450 USD/mo. Add to cost calc and mark as estimate.

billing-bot: attach: please ensure cost_center tags map to billing export stream; otherwise costs will be split incorrectly. Also request daily export to shared billing bucket.

jamie: Quick IAM snippet for service accounts/roles (one-liners):
```
- roles/compute.instanceAdmin for deployer svc
- roles/monitoring.viewer for alerting svc
- roles/billing.user for finance-readonly svc
```

sara: Who's owning the follow-up? We need a single owner to open the vendor cases and follow up.

alex: I'll own initial outreach. I'll open the cases after we lock the numbers. Sara, can you finalize the list of instances and exact counts by EOD?

sara: Yep, will do. Putting the final doc in INFRA-PRFL-2026 and pinging here when done.

mike: If approvals take >48h we should pre-warm by reserving a couple of spot/ondemand fallbacks in us-central1. I'll prepare a quick terraform snippet for fallback pool.

alex: Perfect. Thanks all — once Sara pushes final counts I'll open support tickets and attach the templates. :rocket:

infra-bot: Reminder scheduled: follow-up in 2 days for ticket status.
